question: A person covers a distance of 8 km in 56 minutes. If he covers half of the distance in two-third of the total time, then what should his speed (in km/h) be to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time?
solution:
**Given:**

A person covers a distance of 8 km in 56 minutes. If he covers half of the distance in two-third of the total time, then what should his speed (in km/h) be to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time?

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculations:**

Total distance = 8 km

Total time = 56 minu
